conf.comment: System log, syslog-csv, direct route. recommendations.direct.cribl (verbatim): 'Ship the thin envelope (_dataId, @timestamp, host, _raw) for this low-volume route instead of teaching the edge pipeline every PAN-OS system subtype grammar... attach the device-to-owner/site enrichment at the edge worker group where the inventory lookup already lives.' Per brief rule 4 this recommendation outranks the generic per-field parse the sibling threat/traffic/userid/globalprotect pipelines in this directory received. Device-to-owner enrichment is NOT implemented: no lookup CSV is supplied anywhere in this work order, and the brief forbids inventing one. 'Validate against a Schema Library schema with a dead-letter route' is also not implemented: Schema Library is a Cribl platform/Destination-side data-quality feature, not one of the whitelisted Pipeline functions, so it is out of scope for a Pipelines-only deliverable.
